note: Eldorado NF campground on the north shore of Ice House Reservoir in the Crystal Basin, reached on paved Ice House Road and FR 32. Meadow Loop (sites 2-29) sits on the west cove and Boulder Loop (30-68) to the east; self-contained rigs may also camp on the boat ramp (69-81). Boulder Loop's lake-side sites look over the water from open granite well above full pool. --Claude
